authority: Point-data audit revision only. No clothing design adoption, Human approval, or renderer integration.
coordinateSystem: pixel coordinates, origin top-left, x right, y down, exported 256x256 canvas before scene scaling.
measurementMethod: All 54 runtime frames were individually reviewed at 2x with a labeled 16-source-pixel grid; each source PNG SHA256 and runtime frame index was checked. R003 changes only freeHand points where R002 visibly missed the non-staff gesture hand; other R002 points are retained as visually rechecked candidates, not alpha-derived facts. Unknown remains explicit where the hand is obscured or inseparable from the authored staff grip. Approximate visual placement; not pixel segmentation or Human art approval.

coverage.frameIndexContract: LayeredWitchMotion.play enumerates each state clip frames array from index 0; frameIndex/runtimeFrameIndex equal that local index.

landmarkSemantics.neckAnchor: visible base-of-neck/collar junction; unknown where hair/collar hides the joint
landmarkSemantics.chestAnchor: visible upper-torso/bodice center, independent of neck
landmarkSemantics.waistCenter: per-frame belt/waist seam center preserved from r001; unknown only if source record was unavailable
landmarkSemantics.visibleRightAnkle: screen-right visible boot/ankle center, not anatomical laterality
landmarkSemantics.freeHand: non-staff/gesture hand center; unknown when occluded or indistinguishable from authored staff-hand pivot
landmarkSemantics.coordinateFrame: top-left origin, x right, y down, source 256x256 pixels
